# rustlab

> Rust-native matrix algebra + DSP toolkit with a scriptable language (`.rlab`),
> an interactive REPL, a Markdown notebook renderer, and terminal/file/HTML plotting.
> Numerics are complex-by-default, indexing is 1-based, ~327 builtins across
> math, linear algebra (dense + sparse), statistics, FFT/spectral, FIR/IIR filter
> design, fixed-point, control systems, RF S-parameters, and vector calculus.

Run a script: `rustlab run script.rlab --plot none`   REPL: `rustlab`
Render a notebook: `rustlab-notebook render note.md`
Note: runtime errors print `error: line N: ...` to stderr but the exit code
stays 0 — check stderr, not the exit code.

## Docs

- [docs/agent-guide.md](docs/agent-guide.md): START HERE — how to use rustlab as an
  agent: execution model, the language in 20 rules, pitfalls, plotting/output
  recipes, notebook authoring, toolbox map, verification workflow
- [docs/quickref.md](docs/quickref.md): canonical capability index — every builtin
  with one-line description; if a function is not listed here it does not exist
- [docs/functions.md](docs/functions.md): full signatures, semantics, and a usage
  example for every builtin, grouped by toolbox
- [docs/notebooks.md](docs/notebooks.md): complete notebook reference — directives,
  widgets, embeds, template interpolation, render/watch/check/clean CLI
- [docs/examples.md](docs/examples.md): annotated walkthroughs of the example scripts
- [README.md](README.md): install, quickstart, CLI usage

## Examples

- [examples/](examples/): 81 runnable .rlab scripts, one directory per toolbox
  (language, math, linalg, stats, sparse, dsp, spectral, controls, rf, pde,
  plot, audio, notebooks)
- [gallery/](gallery/): 38 rendered notebooks with inline plots, browsable on GitHub

## Programmatic discovery

- `rustlab docs --json`: complete builtin index as JSON
  ({name, toolbox, subcategory, brief, detail}) — one call gives the whole API
- `rustlab docs <name>`: detail for one builtin; `rustlab docs --search <q>`: search

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): for agents modifying the rustlab codebase itself
  (crate layout, workflow rules, test strategy) — not needed to use the tool
- [docs/sparse_solve.md](docs/sparse_solve.md): sparse direct-solver design notes
